question_en: What does Microsoft do to assess and defend against cybersecurity risks, according to its fiscal 2024 10-K?
question_vi: Theo báo cáo 10-K năm tài chính 2024, Microsoft đánh giá và phòng vệ trước các rủi ro an ninh mạng bằng những cách nào?
reference_answer: Microsoft's ERM organization runs a semiannual risk assessment that covers cybersecurity, using a COSO-based framework aligned with ISO 31000:2018, and its environments are reviewed by internal audit and third-party assessors. It monitors continuously for vulnerabilities, builds security in through its Security Development Lifecycle and zero-trust architecture, uses AI-powered tools on over 78 trillion daily signals, tracks over 300 threat actors, and runs a Cyber Defense Operations Center with over 10,000 security experts.

evidence_groups.quote: The Enterprise Risk Management (“ERM”) organization supports management in this commitment by facilitating the semiannual risk assessment, which documents the priority and status of these risks and aligns them with our strategic mitigation efforts.
We integrate security into our computing environments, products, and services through our Security Development Lifecycle (“SDL”).

question_en: How exposed is NVDA to currency swings, per its fiscal 2025 10-K, and what would a 10% move against it do to its hedges?
question_vi: Theo 10-K năm tài chính 2025, NVDA chịu rủi ro tỷ giá đến mức nào, và nếu tỷ giá biến động bất lợi 10% thì các hợp đồng phòng ngừa của công ty bị ảnh hưởng ra sao?
reference_answer: NVIDIA calls its direct FX exposure minimal because substantially all sales are in U.S. dollars and forward contracts offset currency moves. A 10% stronger dollar would have lowered AOCI from its FX contracts by $136 million (January 26, 2025) and $116 million (January 28, 2024), and an adverse 10% change on balance sheet hedges would have cut pre-tax income by $129 million and $60 million, largely offset by remeasurement of the hedged items.

evidence_groups.quote: We consider our direct exposure to foreign exchange rate fluctuations to be minimal as substantially all of our sales are in United States dollars and foreign currency forward contracts are used to offset movements of foreign currency exchange rates.

If the U.S. dollar strengthened by 10% as of January 26, 2025 and January 28, 2024, the amount recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) related to our foreign exchange contracts before tax effect would have been $136 million and $116 million lower, respectively.

If an adverse 10% foreign exchange rate change was applied to our balance sheet hedging contracts, it would have resulted in an adverse impact on income before taxes of $129 million and $60 million as of January 26, 2025 and January 28, 2024, respectively.

question_en: In AAPL's fiscal 2021 10-K, what three things are its internal control policies over financial reporting meant to ensure?

reference_answer: Apple says its internal control policies and procedures (i) keep records that accurately and fairly reflect transactions and dispositions of assets, (ii) give reasonable assurance that transactions are recorded so GAAP financial statements can be prepared and that receipts and expenditures follow management and director authorizations, and (iii) give reasonable assurance of preventing or timely detecting unauthorized acquisition, use or disposition of assets that could materially affect the financial statements.

evidence_groups.quote: (i) pertain to the maintenance of records that, in reasonable detail, accurately and fairly reflect the transactions and dispositions of the Company’s assets;

(ii) provide reasonable assurance that transactions are recorded as necessary to permit preparation of financial statements in accordance with GAAP, and that the Company’s receipts and expenditures are being made only in accordance with authorizations of the Company’s management and directors; and

(iii) provide reasonable assurance regarding prevention or timely detection of unauthorized acquisition, use, or disposition of the Company’s assets that could have a material effect on the financial statements.

question_en: Where do AAPL's EU Digital Markets Act investigations stand as of its Q1 FY2026 10-Q?

reference_answer: The Commission fined Apple €500 million in April 2025 in the Article 5(4) investigation on App Store steering and ordered it to lift restrictions; Apple has appealed. In the separate Article 6(4) investigation the Commission issued preliminary findings in April 2025, and a final violation finding could bring a cease and desist order and fines of up to 10% of annual worldwide net sales; Apple says it complies with the DMA.

evidence_groups.quote: On April 23, 2025, the Commission fined the Company €500 million in the Article 5(4) Investigation and issued a cease and desist order requiring the Company to remove technical and commercial restrictions
Also on April 23, 2025, the Commission issued preliminary findings in the Article 6(4) Investigation.

Challenges or failures in applying current security patches to all hardware and devices connected to our systems, including legacy network equipment, have and may continue to result in unauthorized access to our IT systems and data in the future.
